create_OneVsRestClassifier: create a OneVsRestClassifier meta-estimator to turn a binary classifier into a multiclass classifier using one-vs-the-rest strategy
create_OneVsOneClassifier: create a OneVsOneClassifier meta-estimator to turn a binary classifier into a multiclass classifier using one-vs-one strategy
create_OutputCodeClassifier: create an OutputCodeClassifier meta-estimator using error-correcting output codes with a configurable code size

refactor_OneVsRestClassifier_predict_pro: refactor the OneVsRestClassifier predict_proba method to return normalized class membership probabilities
